description.zh: 离线 Material 角色卡插件：角色、群组、角色编辑器及内置的记忆库、USER.md 和记忆图谱。业务记录通过插件 Storage 接口保存；旧角色卡和记忆由应用启动迁移统一导入。
description.en: An offline Material character plugin with groups, an editor, memory libraries, USER.md and graphs. Domain records use plugin Storage; application startup centrally imports legacy characters and memories.
